goal: Create consistent API response utilities and establish authenticated, Zod-validated Socket.io infrastructure so feature agents can build on it safely.

tasks.title: Implement shared API utilities
steps: Implement: withAuth(handler), errorResponse(message,status,details?), successResponse(data,status), methodGuard(allowed, handler)
verification: Utilities are importable and return consistent JSON shapes

tasks.title: Implement /api/users/me endpoints
steps: GET: return authenticated user's profile (id,name,email,created_at), exclude password_hash
PATCH: validate name with z.string().min(2), update user name for authenticated user
verification: PATCH updates name with validation and returns updated profile

tasks.title: Enforce contract usage guidance
steps: Document (in comments) that all protected routes must use withAuth and all bodies must use validateOrThrow
Make helper signatures ergonomic so feature agents will naturally use them
verification: Feature agent can easily adopt utilities without custom patterns

must_provide: Example route handler using withAuth + validateOrThrow

depends_on_outputs_from: AuthenticationAgent: JWT verification approach + session identity

tasks.title: Create custom server.ts and initialize Socket.io
steps: Create /server.ts as Next.js + Node HTTP server entry point
verification: Server boots and socket server listens without errors

tasks.title: Implement socket auth middleware
steps: Set socket.data.userId on success, reject on failure

tasks.title: Implement in-memory location store + handler stubs
steps: Wire event listeners: update_location, send_voice_message, send_stress_signal
Validate payloads using validateSocketEvent before calling handler stubs
verification: Invalid payload emits error and does not crash server

must_provide: How to start server with socket (node server.ts or npm script)
Event name list and expected payload shapes

integration_checkpoint.name: Checkpoint C — API + Socket Gate
must_pass: GET /api/users/me returns safe user profile when authenticated
Socket server starts and listens on SOCKET_PORT
Socket event payloads are Zod validated before handler stubs are invoked
commands: npm run dev (or npm run server if separate)

stop_condition_to_advance: Checkpoint C passes and both API and socket foundations are stable for feature development.
